annotations.title: Base gas-cost estimates under priority-fee scenarios

description: Estimates Base gas costs from current fees and priority-fee presets. Fixed gas units (100k simple, 250k complex, 180k liquidity) are typical assumptions, not transaction-specific estimates or quotes. Valid values: standard, high-mev (3x priority fee), low-gas (half); invalid values return HTTP 400 without charge. No transaction simulation, mempool observation, or MEV/sandwich-risk measurement. Use to budget gas for a Base transaction. Example: scenario=standard. Price $0.04/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
